summary.en-US: Send selected web text and links to your Oh My Pi prompt.

description.en-US:
Send selected text and its page link from Firefox to your Oh My Pi (OMP) prompt.

How to use
1. Select text on an ordinary HTTP(S) page.
2. Press Ctrl+Alt+K on Linux/Windows or Command+Alt+K on macOS, or right-click and choose Send selection and link to OMP.
3. Review the context in OMP before submitting. If direct delivery is unavailable, paste the copied context from your clipboard.

GitHub pull-request selections retain richer source context. Firefox-protected pages and local files are excluded.

Direct delivery requires the OMP plugin and a separate Linux native-messaging host. Clipboard fallback works without the host. Setup and troubleshooting: https://github.com/klondikemarlen/omp-send-context/blob/main/docs/product/firefox.md

Context is captured only when you invoke a command. The add-on does not persist page context or collect telemetry. Review selected text before sending it to your model.

developer_comments.en-US:
Opt-in diagnostics are session-only and omit selected text, URLs, titles, prompts, and bridge credentials.

Source and quick start: https://github.com/klondikemarlen/omp-send-context
Development and release instructions: https://github.com/klondikemarlen/omp-send-context/blob/main/docs/workflows/firefox-publishing.md
